mapper.insert: INSERT INTO avidity_alarm_history (alarm_id, virtual_device_id, device_name, alarm_name, message, state, alarm_level, alarm_group_name, triggered_time, synced_at) VALUES (#{alarmId}, #{virtualDeviceId}, #{deviceName}, #{alarmName}, #{message}, #{state}, #{alarmLevel}, #{alarmGroupName}, #{triggeredTime}, #{syncedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state = VALUES(state), message = VALUES(message), triggered_time = VALUES(triggered_time), synced_at = VALUES(synced_at)
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(triggered_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM avidity_alarm_history WHERE alarm_name = #{alarmName} AND triggered_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(triggered_time) ORDER BY d
